items.title: 4.1.3.1 Infix, Postfix, and Prefix Notations; Converting an Infix Expression to Postfix (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of notations and conversion (PDF 97-98).

blocks.text: Postfix aur prefix ko amal ki tarteeb dikhane ke liye qausain nahi chahiyein; + A x B C mein pehle B aur C ki zarb hoti phir A jorta hai.
Stack se infix ko postfix banana

items: Khali stack aur khali output list se shuru karein, aur expression baen se daen parhein.
Operator: pehle stack par barabar ya zyada tarjeeh wale operators output mein pop karein, phir naya operator push karein.
Daen qaus: baen qaus tak operators output mein pop karein, phir qaus chhor dein.
Aakhir mein baqi tamam operators output mein pop karein.

blocks.text: Misal: 3 + 4 * 2. 3 parha: output [3]. + parha: stack [+]. 4 parha: output [3, 4]. * parha: + se zyada tarjeeh, to push: stack [+, *]. 2 parha: output [3, 4, 2]. Aakhir: sab pop: 3 4 2 * +.

blocks.prompt: Infix se postfix banate waqt stack kis cheez ko sambhalta hai (MCQ 4)?
blocks.explanation: (d) operators ki tarjeeh aur qausain dono.

blocks.prompt: Long question 4: (5 + 2) * (3 - 1) ko stack se postfix banayein, har token ke baad stack aur output dikhate hue.
blocks.explanation: ( stack [(], output []; 5 output [5]; + stack [(, +]; 2 output [5, 2]; ) + pop: stack [], output [5, 2, +]; * stack [*]; ( stack [*, (]; 3 output [5, 2, +, 3]; - stack [*, (, -]; 1 output [5, 2, +, 3, 1]; ) - pop: stack [*], output [5, 2, +, 3, 1, -]; aakhir: * pop: postfix 5 2 + 3 1 - *, jis ka jawab 7 x 2 = 14.

items: Infix A + B, postfix A B +, prefix + A B; badalte waqt stack operators aur qausain rakhta hai: 3 + 4 * 2 se 3 4 2 * +.
